description: Energy of today in kWh from a power point in kW (trapezoid sum of the samples), back to 0 at local midnight; gaps over 15 min add nothing.

integrate.expr: if (state.day ?? 0) != day.v { state.day = day.v; state.kwh = 0.0; state.t = (); state.p = (); } let last_t = state.t ?? p.t; let last_p = state.p ?? p.v; let dt_h = (p.t - last_t).to_float() / 3600000000.0; if dt_h > 0.0 && dt_h < 0.25 { state.kwh += (last_p + p.v) / 2.0 * dt_h; } state.t = p.t; state.p = p.v; state.kwh
